description: Machine-readable transcription of the tabulated C_Nα and x_cp values from the SP-7224 worked example. These are the exact numbers our aero module must reproduce. Any discrepancy indicates a formula or transcription error in our Barrowman implementation.

nose_cone.note: For a conical nose, C_Nα = 2 (slender body limit) and x_cp = 2/3 * L_nose

body_tube.note: Cylindrical body contributes zero C_Nα in linear Barrowman theory

validation_notes: All TODO values must be transcribed from the original SP-7224 report before the aero unit tests can assert against them.
The report is available from NASA NTRS: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19680011815
Tolerance: our implementation must match to 4 significant figures (0.01%).
The conical nose values (C_Nα=2, x_cp=2/3·L) are exact and can be asserted immediately.
